name: Adventure Creator
desc: Adventure Creator is a fairly simple adventure game creator/editor. You can create rooms and hallways, with treasure chests, monsters, and traps that must be avoided. Games can be saved to disk, but you need the Adventure Creator cartridge to play them. Adventures can also be automatically randomly generated. The games you create are fairly limited, with only one monster allowed per screen, and three types of weapons to hobble the monster with. The goal of the adventures is to find some named object. However the object you seek is really only a name, and is not represented graphically.

name: Aegean Voyage
desc: Aegean Voyage challenges you to sail the Aegean with clever thinking, land on islands and gather clues from oracles. Every wrong move can wreck your ship, and every decision can mean fortune or doom. Only those who connect the clues wisely will find the mythical treasures. But danger lurks everywhere – from monsters to ancient gods. Along the way, you'll explore Greek mythology and sharpen your strategic reasoning.

name: After the War
desc:
Year 2019, Manhattan. After a nuclear war.
Out of the ashes comes a hero, Jonathan Rogers, better known as "Jungle Rogers", the owner of the asphalt jungle. The only chance of survival is to reach the airdrop platform XV-238, located in the control base of the schizophrenic assassin professor McJerin, and to escape to outer colonies.
There is no easy way to do this. The game is a side-scrolling shoot 'em up, with thugs coming at you constantly, and a few moves to use on them. You must cross the dangerous streets of Manhattan, which have become over-run by feral thieves. Later he awaits for the guardians of the scientific complex of McJerin.

name: Alf in the Color Caves
file: Alf in the Color Caves (USA, Europe).zip
desc: Alf in the Color Caves has you guiding bouncy blue ALF through a maze of colorful shapes. You'll move through wriggling, squishy, and zig-zag obstacles while dodging the mischievous Wufflegumps who block your way. Only smart moves will lead ALF to the color space at the end. Make it there safely, and he'll reward you with his rainbow-colored dance and special music – a vibrant journey full of motion and surprises.

name: Alien Sidestep
desc: Alien Sidestep challenges you to delay an alien invasion for as long as possible by preventing enemy units from landing. The aliens behave surprisingly intelligently, dodging your shots and moving faster as their numbers thin out. Each wave increases the tension as new alien types appear and the margin for error shrinks. Once four aliens manage to get past your defenses and land, the game ends in defeat.

name: Alpha Build
desc: Alpha Build is a child-friendly educational game where you control a penguin named Perry and collect letters to deliver them to the correct trucks. By placing the letters properly, parts of a city are gradually constructed in several stages, giving visible progress as you play. Each section increases in complexity, moving from basic letter recognition to ordering, matching, and eventually working with words. The appeal comes from combining movement, thinking, and learning in a playful way that makes progress both clear and rewarding.

name: Alphabet Zoo
desc: Alphabet Zoo has you racing through a maze from a top-down view, collecting scattered letters. In the center, a picture shows the word you're working with, and that determines which letters you need. One mode has you grabbing the first letter of the object as many times as possible before time runs out, while the other makes you collect all letters of the word in the correct order. Teleporters shuffle you around randomly, adding a bit of chaos. You can play alone or against another player, choose uppercase, lowercase or mixed letters, and start on any level you like.

name: Arnie Armchair's Howzat Cricket Game
file: Arnie Armchair's Howzat Cricket Game (USA, Europe).zip
desc: Arnie Armchair's Howzat Cricket Game is a one or two player cricket game that can be played using a keyboard or joystick. It offers three modes: a limited overs game, a one-day game, or a test match, with increasing game length. In Armchair Cricket mode, the game dictates the player names, while in Personal Team Selection mode, you can enter your own team names. The game begins with a cricket pitch on which the bowler, wicket-keeper, and two opposing batsmen are positioned. The player selects a bowler (fast, medium, spin, or bouncer) and starts the game. When batting, the player can control direction using the fire and directional keys, releasing at the last moment for maximum power. Fielders can stop the ball or throw it to the wicket for a run-out. Dismissal appeals, such as for LBW, are not automatic and can be overturned by the umpire.

name: Astroblitz
desc: In Astroblitz, you pilot a high-speed rocket plane tasked with clearing a hostile planet. You destroy flying saucers, radar dishes, spinners, and seekers while dodging volcano blasts and enemy fire. A radar at the top of the screen helps you locate threats and strike before they get too close. Survive each wave to progress, but collisions and shrapnel are deadly. Only sharp aim and quick reflexes will keep you alive.

name: Attack of the Mutant Camels
desc:
Attack of the Mutant Camels (better known as Matrix: Gridrunner 2) is the sequel to Gridrunner.  In this Centipede style game you play a retired captain of a starship, one of those who had won the previous war against aliens.  You come out of retirement because the aliens are back, tougher than ever.  Thus a second gridwar begins.
You pilot your ship and shoot at chains of pods coming at you.  As you hit the pods, they break into smaller independent chains.  The aliens seem to have a sense of humor, though.  Each pod in the chain coming at you looks like a...camel.  Flying camels from outer space.

name: Attack of the Mutant Camels
file: Gridrunner II - Attack of the Mutant Camels (USA).zip
desc:
Attack of the Mutant Camels (better known as Matrix: Gridrunner 2) is the sequel to Gridrunner.  In this Centipede style game you play a retired captain of a starship, one of those who had won the previous war against aliens.  You come out of retirement because the aliens are back, tougher than ever.  Thus a second gridwar begins.
You pilot your ship and shoot at chains of pods coming at you.  As you hit the pods, they break into smaller independent chains.  The aliens seem to have a sense of humor, though.  Each pod in the chain coming at you looks like a...camel.  Flying camels from outer space.

name: Avengers (MAX)
desc: "Avengers" is a classic shoot-'em-up based on the well-known "Space Invaders" concept. Players control a cannon at the bottom of the screen and must shoot waves of advancing alien formations before they reach Earth. Flying saucers occasionally appear, offering extra points when hit. Quick reflexes and precise aiming are key to achieving high scores and surviving as long as possible.

name: Badlands
desc:
Badlands continued the Super Sprint lineage, but moved the game into a futuristic post-apocalyptic setting. The races consist of 3 souped-up cars toughing it out over 4 laps on one of the 8 tracks, which are viewed from above. Two human players can take part, but only the winner continues without using up credits, so you will only see the early races in two-player mode.
You are armed with guns, which can be used to slow opposing cars. During the races spanners can be collected, which are then cashed in for upgraded turbos, improved weaponry and engine upgrades. Hazards on the later tracks include ramps, bridges, buildings collapsing onto the track and barriers which open and close in a random sequence.

name: Batman : The Movie
desc: “Batman: The Movie” lets you relive the Dark Knight's adventure from the 1989 film across five varied game segments – from leaping through the chemical plant and speeding away in the Batmobile, to solving puzzles in the Batcave, cutting toxic balloon ropes with the Batjet, and facing the Joker in a final cathedral showdown that will decide the fate of Gotham City.

name: Battle Command
desc: Battle Command is a 3D arcade/strategy game, loosely derived from the same developers' Carrier Command. In a near future alternate reality, the Ultra War is fought between the two dominate races in the New World. The 'Mauler' is the latest technology - an Armored Fighting Machine capable of being lifted in and out of hostile territory by a fast Stealth Chopper, and armed with the most advanced weaponry science can devise. You command a single "Mauler" assault tank in one of a series of scenarios. These range from a railway ambush to escort duties and a raid on a riverside hideout. Before starting you must choose the right weaponry based on the mission briefing.

name: Battlezone
desc: “Battlezone” puts you in the cockpit of a tank defending Earth against an alien invasion. From a first-person view, you traverse an abstract yet tactically demanding battlefield, targeting enemy tanks, planes, and UFOs. A radar helps you locate enemies by direction and distance, and terrain features can be used for cover. The controls realistically simulate tank treads – combining forward and backward commands allows for quick turns and agile maneuvering. A pioneering 3D action game, still praised for its immersive atmosphere and strategic gameplay.

name: BC's Quest for Tires
desc: Cute Chick is in trouble! She is being held captive by the dinosaur, and it is up to Thor to ride his trusty wheel to the rescue. There are many obstacles in the way which Thor will need to jump and duck, including rocks, trees, rivers, lava pits, cliffs, and of course Fat Broad. When you duck, the character bounces up and down, so don't duck too soon. BC's Quest For Tires is a side scrolling action game resembling Moon Patrol in some ways, featuring characters from the comic strip BC.

name: Beamrider
desc: In Beamrider, you control a spaceship gliding along five fixed energy beams, tasked with clearing 99 sectors of alien invaders. To complete a sector, you must destroy 15 white flying saucers. Afterward, a sentinel appears that can be shot for bonus points. You're armed with lasers and three torpedoes per level – powerful but limited. Every two sectors introduces a new enemy type that slows you down but doesn't need to be destroyed. Watch for the rejeuvinator: shoot it and it becomes an enemy, collect it and you gain an extra life.

name: Big Bird's Funhouse
desc: Big Bird's Funhouse takes you on a playful journey through a colourful house filled with activities focused on memory, matching, and observation. Alongside Big Bird, you search for hidden friends, remember patterns, and tackle varied challenges that gradually increase in difficulty. Different modes keep each session fresh while helping develop attention and recall skills. The experience blends learning with fun – a friendly game that encourages curiosity, pattern recognition, and playful discovery.

name: Big Bird's Special Delivery
desc: Big Bird's Special Delivery is a computer game for preschool children that allows the player to practice classifying objects. In a playful environment with shops, Big Bird and Little Bird work to deliver mail to one of four locations. This computer activity aims to develop children's understanding of form and function. The objects are controlled by pressing one of three keys on the computer keyboard to control Little Bird. When a game round is completed, the shops will light up after the mail has been delivered correctly. If there is a mail mix-up, store owners gently point out mistakes and encourage the child to try again.

name: Blueprint
developer: B. Hindorff, D. Holmes & C. Merten
desc: In Blueprint, you must save your girlfriend Daisy from Ollie Ogre by assembling a ball-throwing machine. The parts are hidden in houses within a maze, but if you enter a house you've already visited, you get a bomb instead – and must rush it to the bin before it explodes. Time is running out, Daisy is in danger, and monsters and falling flowerpots add to the chaos. Once the machine is complete, hit the button and start launching balls to stop Ollie before he reaches Daisy.

name: Bowling
desc: Bowling is a classic top-down bowling game designed for a single player. In this simple but fun sports game, the player takes control of the bowling ball and tries to knock down as many pins as possible by making accurate throws and scoring strikes or spares. The top-down perspective allows a clear view of the lane and pins, making it easier to plan and accurately score throws. Players can adjust their throwing angle and the strength of the throw to achieve the best results.

name: Bridge 64
desc: In Bridge 64 you compete against the computer in a challenging card game where strategy and teamwork are key. You play as part of a partnership opposing another team, aiming to fulfill your bid or prevent your opponents from doing so. Each round requires careful thinking, as you must use your cards wisely and respond to the moves of others. As difficulty increases, your skills are pushed further, encouraging you to improve and develop new strategies.

name: Bubble Burst
desc: Bubble Burst challenges you to stop the Zeboingers from popping all the bubbles in Soapie's bathtub. You control a crosshair and shoot bubbles at the bird-like intruders before they reach the bath. If they destroy the bubbles, the foam decreases. Each round gives you only a limited amount of bubble juice, after which you can no longer defend yourself. The Zeboingers can also open the window or turn on the shower, which makes the foam vanish even faster. At the start of the game, you can choose to begin at round 1 or round 11.

name: Buck Rogers : Planet of Zoom
file: Buck Rogers - Planet of Zoom (USA, Europe).zip
desc: Buck Rogers: Planet of Zoom is a single player science fiction themed obstacle race, where the player controls Buck Rogers' space ship and must guide it through multiple pairs of pylons throughout the game. Controlling the ship involves side scrolling to the left or right, stop, moving forward (and faster), and moving backwards/break (and slower). Additionally, the spaceship can also fire its weapon to unleash a pair of energy bolts.

name: Bug Crusher
desc: In Bug Crusher you control a small spaceship that can move in all directions to crush pesky bugs. You're safe only inside three bunkers at the edges – step outside and a red enemy will chase you, draining your fuel. Other enemies continuously scroll across the screen. If they hit you or your fuel runs out, you lose a life. With five lives and the option to activate temporary invincibility at the cost of fuel, every move becomes a risky mission.

name: C64 Games System : Fiendish Freddy's Big Top o' Fun / International Soccer / Flimbo's Quest / Klax
file: Fiendish Freddy's Big Top o' Fun + International Soccer + Flimbo's Quest + Klax (Europe) (C 64 Games System).zip
desc: The C64 Games System features four titles in this selection: Fiendish Freddy, a quirky sports satire packed with mini-games and dark humor; International Soccer, a straightforward football game with classic C64 flair; Flimbo's Quest, a colorful platform adventure with shooter elements; and Klax, a fast-paced puzzle game focused on falling tiles and quick reactions. This lineup showcases the variety of classic C64 entertainment – from sports to action and puzzles.

name: Capture II
desc: In Capture II, you take turns collecting pieces and try to finish with the higher score. You can play against the computer or directly against a second player, while the limited number of remaining pieces makes the contest tighter with every move. Each turn can shift the lead – choose wisely and slow your opponent down to secure the better final score.

name: Centipede
desc: Centipede places the player in a mushroom-filled battlefield, controlling a movable gun to fend off various pests. The centipede weaves through the field and splits into multiple segments when hit. The spider devours both mushrooms and the player, while the flea deposits new mushrooms in its wake. The scorpion poisons mushrooms, causing the centipede to plummet uncontrollably upon contact. The game's speed can be adjusted through selectable difficulty levels.

name: Chase HQ II : Special Criminal Investigation
file: Chase H.Q. II - Special Criminal Investigation (Europe).zip
desc: In Chase HQ II: Special Criminal Investigation, you once again chase criminals on the open road, this time with more action and firepower. Before each mission, you are given the profile of your target, which you must locate in traffic. To stop the thug's car, you ram it repeatedly until it loses control – all within the time limit. Compared to the first game, it feels more polished and dynamic, but it places greater emphasis on firepower rather than the classic “car bashing.”

name: Checkers
desc: „Checkers“ is a digital adaptation of the classic board game Checkers. Two players move their pieces diagonally across the board, attempting to capture opponent's pieces by jumping over them. If a piece reaches the opponent's back row, it becomes a king and gains enhanced movement options. Strategic thinking and foresight are key to defeating the opponent.

name: Choplifter!
desc: Choplifter! puts you in the cockpit of an attack helicopter and sends you deep behind enemy lines to rescue trapped hostages. While landing, picking up survivors, and flying them to safety, you are constantly under fire from tanks and hostile aircraft that show no mercy. The blend of risky rescue operations, precise control, and nonstop danger creates intense tension – making every successful mission feel like a hard-earned victory.

name: Close Encounters of the Worst Kind
file: Close Encounters of the Worst Kind (USA, Europe).zip
desc: In Close Encounters of the Worst Kind you control a small ship at the bottom of the screen, moving sideways and firing upward. Waves of alien ships descend rapidly, while a large mothership moves horizontally across the top and shoots back. Only quick reflexes and precise timing will help you survive the alien onslaught.

name: Clowns
desc: The Clowns game was released as a cartridge and is only controlled via paddles in joystick port 1. However, there is also a disk version that can be played using a joystick. The game is about using a bobbing springboard to spin two clowns upwards through the air, thereby collecting colorful balloons. The balloons you collect earn you points. The jumping clown must land exactly on the free area of the board, otherwise he will fall. After three crashes the game is over. There are two platforms each on the right and left. The jumping clown also starts there. Strictly speaking, the gameplay is taken from the game Breakout, except that instead of a ball, two clowns jump across the screen.

name: Coccinelle Cherche Dessinateur
desc: Coccinelle Cherche Dessinateur is less of a game and more a piece of performance art, where you create the final work yourself. The ladybug character acts as a cursor whose colors and the trail it leaves can be altered. By moving the ladybug, patterns emerge, and the variables for what appears on screen are entirely under your control. It's a creative experience that places the player at the heart of artistic creation.

name: Coco-Notes
file: Coco-Notes featuring... the Jazz Scats! (USA, Europe).zip
desc:
A musical game with four modes:
1. Catch a Coco-Note - Pick notes out of a pool with your fishing pool. Once you've picked enough you can hear the band play the melody you've picked out.
2. Composin' Coco-Notes - Same game as the first, except now played with an accompaniment.
3. Beat The Clam - Race against a clam trying to claim notes from the pool and get a high score while finishing the song. Collect bonus notes for extra score and avoid the clam as he'll eat your fishing line as well.
4. Beat The Clam -- Challenge - Same game as above except the clam is much faster.

name: Congo Bongo
desc: In Congo Bongo you play a jungle hunter chasing the gorilla Congo across hazard-filled levels with pits, rivers, wild monkeys, snakes and coconuts. Version 1 (1983) includes two stages with basic visuals; version 2 (1985) on disk adds all four arcade levels with improved graphics. You leap over rivers using hippos, lily pads and piranhas, and must shake off monkeys that cling to your back. Your goal: reach Congo unharmed, one level at a time.

name: Cosmic Life
desc: Cosmic Life places you in a cosmic struggle for survival where strategic placement and forward planning determine success or failure. You deploy space pioneers onto a hostile planetary surface and attempt to build stable colonies that can endure the environmental conditions. Only well-organized groups survive, while limited resources, overcrowding and unpredictable storms constantly threaten growth. At the same time, you must keep an eye on your rival and actively hinder their expansion, as only the strongest colonies will prevail in the end.

name: Crisis Mountain
desc: Crisis Mountain is a classic platform game where you venture into underground caverns to defuse ticking bombs left by terrorists – as a volcano above begins to erupt, you fight through nine increasingly dangerous levels, racing against time to prevent disaster.

name: Crystal Castles
desc: Bentley Bear is trapped in the Crystal Castles! To get out, he will need to collect all of the gems located throughout the castle. The game is played with an isometric view of the multi platformed castle. When Bentley collects all of the gems on the current castle, he will move on to the next, more difficult castle. Wandering throughout the castles are a wide variety of dangerous creatures, which Bentley should avoid. From time to time, a magic hat will appear. If Bentley collects the hat, he will temporarily be invincible to the castles inhabitants.

name: Cyberball
desc:
After American Football players started cheating by using bionic parts, the game was forced to change its rules. By 2022, the game was played not by humans, but two teams of seven robots. To spice things up, the usual pig skin ball was replaced with a 350 pound bomb.
Cyberball brings this fast and furious action to life. Gameplay is essentially the same as the real sport, although the 'downs' are replaced by the bomb's heat gradually increasing towards 'critical'. After this it will explode and possession will be swapped. This is prevented when you cross the 50-yard line, lose possession or score a touchdown, in which cases it resets to 'cool'. Field goals and punts are not featured - the only kick is the initial kick-off you receive.
Control passes from the quarterback (thrower) to the intended catcher as soon as a pass is released. The two-player game is co-operative - on offense one player passes and the other receives

name: Dance Fantasy
desc: Dance Fantasy lets you choreograph digital dancers exactly as you imagine. You choose from eight dance steps, set the duration, direct the movement, and define how the dancers interact. This creates a creative space where kids can unleash their imagination and craft their own little works of art.

name: Dancing Feats
desc: Dancing Feats is a musical game. Arrange your bass, beat, style tempo and endings in different styles such as Jazz, Rock, Blues or Boogie Woogie. Overlay your instrument for playback or just jam and try out different sounds. You can even play acapella, should you so choose. Save your creations on disk for later listening.

name: Decathlon
desc: In Decathlon you compete in ten different athletics events inspired by the Olympic decathlon. Up to four players can take part, either playing through all events in sequence or selecting individual ones. The events include the 100-meter dash, long jump, shot put, high jump, 400-meter race, 110-meter hurdles, discus throw, pole vault, javelin throw and the 1500-meter race. In the running events you rapidly move the joystick to build speed while pressing the button at the right moment, for example to clear hurdles without losing momentum. In the jumping and throwing events you build up power and then release at the correct time to achieve the best result. Points are awarded for each event based on your performance, and the player with the highest total score at the end wins the gold medal.

name: Defender
desc: Defender puts you in control of a fast attack ship defending humanity from endless alien waves. You face foes like Landers, Pods, Swarmers, Baiters, and Bombers — Landers being the most dangerous, abducting humans and turning them into relentless Mutants. Armed with smart bombs and hyperspace jumps, you must eliminate threats swiftly. Fail to save the humans, and they fall — or worse, the planet is destroyed. Reflexes and quick decision-making are key to survival.

name: Delta Drawing
desc: Delta Drawing invites you to create colorful images while learning the basics of programming in a playful way. A small “turtle” moves across the screen, following your commands to build shapes, patterns, and entire scenes step by step. The program uses a simple functional language that lets you define routines, combine colors, and grow your picture through scripted instructions. Aimed at young beginners, it highlights how creative code can be – a learning environment that goes far beyond drawing and shows how ideas take form through precise commands.

name: Der Rechenlöwe : Fit in der Addition und Subtraktion (2./3. Schuljahr)
file: Rechenlowe, Der - Fit in Addition und Subtraktion - 2.-3. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: "Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in der Addition und Subtraktion (2./3. Schuljahr)" helps students improve their addition and subtraction skills. The player must add numbers step by step and enter the correct result. The animated lion guides the learning process in a playful and engaging way.

name: Der Rechenlöwe : Fit in der Addition und Subtraktion (3./4. Schuljahr)
file: Rechenlowe, Der - Fit in Addition und Subtraktion - 3.-4. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: "Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in Addition und Subtraktion (3./4. Schuljahr)" is an educational program for children that playfully trains addition and subtraction. In a simple graphical environment, tasks are presented that students must solve by entering the correct answers. A lion mascot accompanies the process, providing visual feedback. The program was specifically designed for use in school lessons or independent practice.

name: Der Rechenlöwe : Fit in der Geometrie (3./4. Schuljahr)
file: Rechenlowe, Der - Fit in Geometrie - 3.-4. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: "Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in der Geometrie (3./4. Schuljahr)" helps students understand geometric concepts like lines of symmetry in a playful way. The player must determine the number of symmetry axes in the given shapes. The animated lion guides the learning process and makes it an interactive experience.

name: Der Rechenlöwe : Fit in der Mathematik (1. Schuljahr)
file: Rechenlowe, Der - Fit in Mathematik - 1. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: "Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in der Mathematik (1. Schuljahr)" helps children learn basic arithmetic operations such as addition and subtraction. Players solve problems by entering the correct intermediate results. An interactive visual representation aids in developing numerical understanding in a playful manner.

name: Der Rechenlöwe : Fit in der Multiplikation und Division (2./3. Schuljahr)
file: Rechenlowe, Der - Fit in Multiplikation und Division - 2.-3. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: "Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in der Multiplikation und Division (2./3. Schuljahr)" follows an interactive approach to strengthening multiplication and division skills. The Math Lion guides players and encourages them to place the correct numbers into designated fields, helping them explore different calculation methods.

name: Der Rechenlöwe : Fit in der Multiplikation und Division (3./4. Schuljahr)
file: Rechenlowe, Der - Fit in Multiplikation und Division - 3.-4. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: "Der Rechenlöwe: Fit in der Multiplikation und Division (3./4. Schuljahr)" helps students improve their multiplication and division skills. Through interactive exercises and clear visualizations, the program supports the understanding of mathematical concepts. Problems are solved step by step, while the lion acts as a learning companion throughout the program.

name: Diamond Mine
desc: In Diamond Mine, your goal is to collect as many diamonds as possible from twenty underground shafts. Each level is shown on a single screen filled with corridors and passageways. Monsters are periodically released from a central hub and can be shot, but touching one causes you to lose all collected gems. Mines are initially covered in dust, so you can only shoot through areas you've already walked. Since most diamonds are located in the corridors, careful planning is essential. The game allows you to start from one of five different screens.

name: Dig Dug
desc: Dig Dug is a 1-2 player arcade game in which you have to use your shovel to dig your way through the earth. Stopping you from doing this are two monsters, called Pooka and Fygar, who will continually chase you around. The only weapon that you carry is an air pump, which you can use to inflate the monsters to the point where they explode. (if you start to inflate them but stop doing so, the monsters will get turned back to their normal selves.) Furthermore, rocks are scattered throughout the earth, and you can use these rocks to squash them. If the monsters do not find you for several seconds, they will eventually get turned into ghosts, which are able to walk through the earth. They are invincible and cannot be killed. From time to time, vegetables will appear in the center, and you can get these for points.

name: Donkey Kong
desc: Released in the arcades in 1981, Donkey Kong was Nintendo's first real smash hit for the company. Mario scale four different industrial themed levels (construction zone, cement factory, an elevator-themed level, and removing rivets from girders) in an attempt to save the damsel in distress, Pauline, from the big ape before the timer runs out. Once the rivets are removed from the final level, Donkey Kong falls, and the two lovers are reunited. From there, the levels start over at a higher difficulty. Along the way, Mario must dodge a constant stream of barrels, "living" fireballs, and spring-weights. Mario can find a hammer which allows him to destroy the barrels and fireballs for a limited amount of time.

name: Dot Gobbler
desc: “Dot Gobbler” is a classic Pac-Man clone where the player gobbles up dots in a maze while avoiding hungry ghouls. Collecting large power dots grants the player extra strength, allowing them to chase and eat the ghouls for bonus points. Quick thinking and precise maneuvering are essential for success.

name: Double Dragon
desc: Double Dragon follows twin brothers Billy and Jimmy Lee as they take on the brutal Black Warriors gang after Billy's girlfriend Marian is kidnapped in the streets of a post-apocalyptic New York. Refusing to give in to blackmail, they fight back using their martial arts skills and anything they can get their hands on. From city slums and industrial ruins to the depths of the forest, each step brings them closer to the gang's hideout and a final showdown with boss Willy. The path is tough, the enemies relentless, but the Lee brothers won't stop until Marian is safe.

name: DragonsDen
desc: "DragonsDen" puts you in the role of Den, a knight on a flying horse armed with a lance, battling an ever-growing dragon threat. Across multiple phases, you destroy dragon eggs, fend off hatchlings, dodge spiders and blades, survive arrow storms, hatch a massive dragon, and face it in a final duel. With each game cycle, enemies become faster and more aggressive, culminating in a showdown with the ultimate dragon boss. Sharp control and steady nerves are essential to claim victory in this aerial battle.

name: Ducks Ahoy!
desc: In Ducks Ahoy! you navigate a small boat through the canals of Venice to rescue wandering ducks. You can carry up to two ducks at a time and must bring them safely to the shore before they leap into the water. A lurking hippo, revealed only by bubbles, adds danger – if it catches your boat, you lose a life. After rescuing ten ducks, they sing and the game restarts at a higher speed, making each round more challenging.

name: Ernie's Magic Shapes
desc: With the wave of his magic wand, Ernie the Magician makes a shape float over his head. Another wave, and a second shape appears on a table nearby. The player now decides whether or not the two shapes match. If so, and the player agrees, Ernie nods and the two shapes float together before disappearing. If not, Ernie shakes his head "no", waves his wand, and a new shape appears on the table.

name: Espial
desc: Espial puts you in the cockpit of a space attack pilot, engaging in a deadly battle over a massive enemy spaceship. As endless waves of hostile craft swarm toward you, you must fend off their attacks while simultaneously launching missiles and lasers at the enemy vessel. Your missiles strike where your crosshair is aimed at the moment of firing, requiring precise control and quick reflexes. But beware – enemy fire and collisions with flying objects spell certain doom. Do you have what it takes to fight through the relentless onslaught and defeat the overwhelming enemy forces?

name: Facemaker
desc: Facemaker is a delightful and educational game that finally lets you make all the goofy faces your mom once warned you about. Choose from a wide range of eyes, ears, noses, mouths, and hairstyles to create your own unique face. Then bring it to life – it can blink, smile, frown, stick out its tongue, or wiggle its ears at your command. The highlight is a “Simon says…” style game mode where the face performs actions and you have to follow along in the correct sequence. A lovingly crafted game that encourages creativity, observation, and reaction – with guaranteed laughs.

name: Falconian Invaders
desc:
You are at the console of a space fighter attempting to ward off the attacking fleet in a never ending battle to stay alive. Controlled from a viewpoint behind the ship, the player can move in all directions as alien vessels approach. The player receives more points for shooting an alien vessel further away. The player has limited fuel, but receives a bonus for every enemy hit.
There is a regular and advanced mode. In regular mode, the player automatically tracks enemy vessels, and merely needs to position their ship near an alien and fire. In advanced mode, the player must precisely align their ship with the enemy before firing.

name: Fraction Fever
desc: Fraction Fever has you climbing floor by floor using your pogo stick while searching for fraction visuals that match the ones shown on screen. You compare fractions, navigate toward the correct elevators, and rely on a radar to understand the layout of each level. Incorrect choices may score points but create gaps that make movement riskier, requiring precise jumps and careful timing. A strict time limit adds pressure – a learning-focused skill challenge that blends maths, awareness, and movement.

name: Frog Master
desc: Frog Master can be played alone or with two players and offers over 100 different variations, ranging from simple to highly complex gameplay. The playing field has goal lines at both ends and goal areas in the center of each line. The objective is to train the animal players on the screen by clicking when they perform the desired actions. By repeatedly clicking when the tadpoles and frogs move as intended, they gradually learn to follow the player's commands.

name: Frogger + River Raid + Decathlon + Beamrider
file: Frogger + River Raid + Activision Decathlon, The + Beamrider (USA, Europe) (Arcade Classic Pak).zip
desc: Arcade Classic Pak is a collection of four iconic games that bring classic arcade action to your screen. In “Frogger”, you guide a frog through traffic and across a river to reach safe zones. “River Raid” puts you in control of a fighter jet soaring above a river, destroying enemy targets and refueling along the way. “Decathlon” challenges you with multiple Olympic events requiring precision timing and quick reflexes. “Beamrider” drops you into a futuristic grid where you must blast waves of enemies with sharp aim. These four titles offer a variety of gameplay – from agility to reaction – delivering a rich retro experience.

name: Frogger II : Threeedeep!
desc: Frogger II: ThreeeDeep! expands on the classic gameplay and challenges you to bring your frog to safety across three different settings. First, you dive underwater and avoid dangerous fish and alligators – a turtle can be a safe platform here. After surfacing, you leap across logs, birds and even a whale to reach a life ring being towed by a tugboat. In the third section, you must hop across a flock of birds to reach a cloud at the top of the screen. Each frog has limited time to reach one of the homes on each of the three screens, and you move to the next, tougher level only after guiding a frog safely to all homes across all three stages.

name: Fun Play
file: Professional Skateboard Simulator + Fast Food + Pro Tennis Simulator (USA, Europe) (Fun Play).zip
desc:
Fun Play is a collection of three games from Codemasters and contains the following:
Fastfood
Pro Tennis
Pro Skateboard

name: Galaxian
desc: "Galaxian" puts you in control of the Galaxip spaceship at the bottom of the screen, facing alien formations attacking from above. You fire at drones, emissaries, hornets, and commanders – the higher the rank, the more points you earn. Your ship can only fire one shot at a time, so timing and precision are essential. As the game progresses, enemy movement and attack frequency increase, and some foes dive toward you escorted by bombers. Quick reflexes and persistence are key to surviving this iconic space battle.

name: Galaxions & Munch Man
desc: „Galaxions & Munchman“ is a game compilation that brings together two classic arcade experiences. In “Galaxions”, you control a spaceship and fight off waves of alien attackers – fast reflexes and sharp shooting are essential. “Munchman”, on the other hand, is a catch-and-dodge game where you collect items and avoid enemies in a maze-like environment. This compilation delivers two distinct styles of gameplay in one package, offering a mix of space action and classic arcade fun.

name: Gateway to Apshai
desc: In Gateway to Apshai, an ancient prophecy leads you to the entrance of dangerous dungeons where the path to the forgotten temple is said to be hidden. As the descendant of a great hero, the hopes of an entire land rest on you while you make your way through dark corridors, traps, and hostile creatures. Every step can bring you closer to the magic of Apshai – or deeper into an adventure from which many before you never returned.

name: Ghostbusters
desc: Ghostbusters puts you in charge of a ghostbusting team tasked with saving New York from a paranormal disaster. Hired by the mayor and equipped with starting funds, you hunt ghosts across the city, watch the map for new hauntings, and drive through traffic to reach the locations in time. Once there, you deploy proton beams and traps to capture the spirits and lower the city's PK energy level. The money earned can be spent on upgrades and new equipment. But if ghost activity rises too high, the Temple of Zuul awakens along with Gozer – and only if you've been successful enough will you stand a chance in the final showdown.

name: Gorf
desc: Gorf challenges you across four consecutive missions. First, you defend yourself behind a protective shield against aliens in classic formation. In the second stage, the shield is gone, and enemies swoop down in unpredictable patterns while bonus ships appear as extra targets. Next comes a hyperspace flight – from a behind-the-ship perspective, you must endure alien vessels attacking in circular formations until you reach your destination. The final level pits you against a single massive mothership, equipped with the same kind of shield you once had. Only a hit on its glowing weak spot can bring it down instantly.

name: Gridrunner
desc: By the year 2190 the Earth is a barren and desolate wasteland. With all natural resources used up, the human race's last hopes rest with a huge orbiting solar power station know as the GRID. Now the GRID has been invaded by a race of evil droids, intent on the total subjugation of Earth. To combat these droids, an incredibly powerful and manoeuverable ship, the Gridrunner, was developed. Your mission: stop the droids and save the Earth!

name: Gyruss
desc: Gyruss pits you against the deadly Gyrusians attacking the solar system. Piloting a ship that moves in a circular path around the screen's edge, you must clear three enemy waves per planet, traveling from one world to the next. Shoot special satellites to upgrade from a single to a double cannon, and earn bonuses and weapons in post-level stages. With its fast-paced action and unique radial movement, Gyruss delivers a fresh twist on classic arcade shooting.

name: H.E.R.O.
file: H.E.R.O. - Helicopter Emergency Rescue Operation (USA, Europe).zip
desc: H.E.R.O. sends Roderick Hero into a volcano-threatened mine to rescue trapped workers. He must navigate hazardous shafts, dodge lava and dangerous creatures, and find the miners before running out of energy. A prop pack lets him hover, while a helmet-mounted microlaser fends off threats. Dynamite clears stone and lava walls but must be used carefully. If it runs out, the laser works too, though slower and at a higher energy cost. With each level, the mines become more complex, enemies more frequent, and lava deadlier.

name: Halftime Battlin' Bands
file: Halftime Battlin' Bands featuring... the Jazz Scats! (USA, Europe).zip
desc:
Mr. Chrometone here with play-by-play info on all the exciting action in HALFTIME BATTLIN' BANDS!
I hang out with the Jazz Scats - Swivel Hips, Wahoo and Mr. Bassman — a talented trio that'll cheer you on during a spectacular halftime extravaganza that's about to set the world on its musical ear! It's halftime at Jazz Scat Stadium and the fans are cheering for entertainment. As Drum Major of the number one football band, the scrimmage Stompers, it's up to you to create a perfect band formation — along with a sizzlin' new march — out on the football field!
You can kick off all the fun and action right now by plopping the enclosed record onto the ol' phonograph. In four short minutes, you'll have a showstoppin' musical introduction to this Halftime game. And ol' Chrometone here will fill you in on a batch of details to boot!

name: Hop Along Counting
desc: How many bunnies can you count? Pick the right number and tuck them into bed. All that children need is a little encouragement, and their natural curiosity about numbers will take over. They'll love sending Mommy rabbit around the field to find the correct number of baby bunnies. They'll be proud when they lead the bunnies to the matching burrow and watch them hope one by one into their bunny beds.

name: Human Anatomy Series : Skeleton Bones Tutorial
desc: "Human Anatomy Series - Skeleton Bones Tutorial" is an educational program that teaches you the names of all the bones in the human body. A detailed skeleton graphic is used for illustration, but the program always runs in the same sequence, making it easy to memorize after a few rounds. It is a compact and straightforward program focused on the essentials.

name: International Soccer
desc: International Soccer gives you fast-paced arcade football action without big tournaments or leagues – instead, you only play friendly matches with two halves of 200 seconds each. You can either face the AI with nine levels of difficulty or compete against another human player. Each team fields seven players, and you always control the one closest to the ball, while the AI handles your teammates. Corner kicks and throw-ins are included, but there are no fouls – so no yellow or red cards to worry about. Using the joystick's fire button, you can pass or shoot, and movement is possible in all eight directions.

name: Jack Attack
desc: “Jack Attack” is a challenging action-puzzle game where you must defeat all enemies on a rectangular grid. You can push or drop blocks to crush foes—either by trapping them between two blocks or by dropping one on top of them. Be careful, though: if a block or an enemy lands on you, you lose a life. Some levels feature water, which is deadly to you but safe for enemies. In addition to eliminating all foes, bonus points can be earned by stepping on every platform, which disappear after a set time. Speed is also rewarded with extra points for quick level completion.

name: James Bond
desc: In James Bond 007 you control James Bond in his multi purpose craft. This craft can travel on both land and sea, can jump over danger, or fire at enemies on the many different levels. Each horizontally scrolling level in the game is loosely based on a different James Bond movie. The levels included are Diamonds Are Forever, The Spy Who Loved Me, Moonraker, and For Your Eyes Only. Each level has a variety of enemies trying to destroy you, and a unique goal that must be accomplished to continue on (for example, you may have to land on a hidden oil rig to stop Seraffino, or find Stromberg's undersea laboratory and destroy it). If you can complete all the missions, you win the game! Good luck, Mr. Bond.

name: Jaw Breaker
desc: Jaw Breaker places you on a screen with five horizontal lanes, where your task is to eat all the candies to move on to the next level. Watch out – smiling faces chase you down, and touching them costs a life. Occasionally, a lollipop appears in the center of the maze for extra points. In the four corners are special dots that change the maze's color, giving you a short chance to eat the faces instead. The maze will flash again as a warning before returning to normal. Moving openings between the lanes let you switch paths – but they can also trap you if a face gets too close.

name: Juice!
desc: Juice! puts you in control of Edison, the kinetic android, who must battle through six levels of increasing intensity. Your goal is to complete a working circuit while a host of electrical enemies try to stop you. Nohms appear suddenly, bouncing around the grid – one touch and Edison melts away. When they vanish, they leave behind capacitors that quickly evolve into deadly Killerwatts, hunting you relentlessly. Your only aid comes from Recharges, which restore your energy. But beware – Flash, the lightning dolt, tears apart your hard work and adds further chaos to the challenge. Only quick reflexes and persistence will allow you to complete the circuits and secure Edison's mission.

name: Juke Box
desc: In "Juke Box," you combine music, strategy, and skill as you compete against the computer or another player. Your goal is to create golden records on the game board by moving from tile to tile and completing golden discs. The more records you produce, the more coins you earn to keep the music playing. Plan your moves carefully, as getting stuck in a dead end ends the game and silences the music. Keep the rhythm alive and showcase your strategic prowess!

name: Jumpman Junior
desc: Jumpman Junior is the sequel to Jumpman and features similar gameplay with all new levels. As Jumpman, your goal is to disarm all of the bombs on the level before time runs out. Each level consists of a variety of platforms, ladders, and ropes you will need to jump and climb to reach the bombs. To make the game more challenging, a bullet will fire on the screen from time to time which will cause Jumpman to lose a life if hit. Each level has a different theme to it, and a few also have additional dangers as well. You will encounter deadly fires, the bouncing hellstones, moving ladders, disappearing platforms, and more.

name: Jungle Hunt
desc: Jungle Hunt sends you through four perilous jungle stages to rescue Penelope from cannibals. You swing across vines, dive into a crocodile-infested river with only a knife, dodge tumbling boulders, and face a spear-wielding cannibal in a final showdown. Each round gets faster and tougher – only quick reflexes, courage and determination will lead to her rescue.

name: Jupiter Lander
desc: In Jupiter Lander you control a spaceship battling Jupiter's gravity, aiming for a safe touchdown on one of three landing pads. Speed and fuel consumption are critical: land within the yellow zone for points and a fuel refill. Harder pads give higher score multipliers. Crash too hard or hit the cliffs, and you're done. Run out of fuel, and the mission's over. A simple yet demanding test of precision and control.

name: Kickman
desc: You control the skillful unicyclist. Your job is to rack up points by breaking and catching balloons, ghosts, and PAC-MAN on your head.

name: Kids on Keys
desc: Kids on Keys combines three small learning games that help young computer beginners practice reading and typing. In the first game you type falling letters before they hit the ground – and later full words tossed down by the game's mascot. The second game focuses on full object names: everyday items float downward, and you must type their names correctly. In the third game a word appears at the bottom, and you enter the number of the matching icon shown on the screen. Bonus rounds in the second and third tasks partially hide the icons, forcing you to rely more on memory. Together, the three challenges form a playful training course that steadily sharpens recognition, reaction and typing skills.

name: Kindercomp
desc: An early learning game for kids aged 3-8. This program is a collection of 6 learning games: Draw, Scribble, Names, Sequence, Letters and Match.

name: Kung-Fu Master
desc: A conversion of the arcade game of the same name, which itself is loosely based on a movie, Kung-Fu Master is a side scrolling action game for one or two players, who alternate turns. Mr. X has captured the pickpocket Sylvia and it is up to Thomas, a kung-fu master who owns a restaurant, to get her back. She is located on the top floor of Mr. X's castle and Thomas will need to fight his way to the top. Of course, this won't be easy as each floor has many opponents to get past and a floor boss at the end of each level. Thomas is able to move left and right, jump, duck, and punch and kick. Enemy projectiles such as knives can be kicked in the air to rebound them towards the enemy. On the top floor resides Mr. X himself.

name: Laser Cycles
desc: "Laser Cycles" is an adaptation of the light cycle scene from the film "Tron". The aim is to defeat the opponent through clever maneuvering by getting them to collide with their light trail or that of the player. "Laser Cycles" is characterized by its simple controls and competitive gameplay.

name: Laser Zone
desc: Laser Zone puts you in control of two "Zone Gunners" – one on the wall, one on the floor – using a single joystick. You must shoot incoming waves of enemies before they reach the walls, where they become untouchable and close in on you. You can move beyond screen edges, but when enemies reach your zone, things get dangerous. Use an Electric Bolt to wipe the screen in emergencies. Reflexes, awareness, and timing are key to survival.

name: Last Ninja Remix
desc: "Ninja Remix" is a revised version of "The Last Ninja," in which the player once again takes on the role of Armakuni. During training, he is teleported to modern-day New York, where he must battle his arch-enemy, Shogun Kunitoki. The game features an isometric perspective, various combat techniques, and weapons like shuriken or swords. In addition to fighting, puzzles must be solved and items such as keys or ropes strategically used. The re-release as "The Last Ninja Remix" introduced graphical improvements, a new introduction, and a revised soundtrack.

name: Lazarian
desc: Lazarian puts you in command of a spaceship on rescue missions for stranded vessels. You'll face meteorites, aliens, and flying eyes, all of which threaten to destroy your ship. Sharp shooting and careful dodging are key as each level pushes you further into hostile space.

name: Le Mans
desc: Le Mans challenges you to a fast-paced race against the clock where speed alone is not enough – clean driving matters just as much. You need to overtake as many cars as possible to score points and earn extra time, but the other drivers make that task harder with their often unpredictable behaviour. The conditions also keep changing – sending you onto icy roads, through bends, into night driving, and along motorways. Every crash costs precious seconds because you have to reach the mobile PIT first, while also knocking back your progress. That mix of pressure, risk, and shifting road conditions gives the game a tense and engaging racing atmosphere.

name: Leaderboard Golf
file: Leader Board - Pro Golf Simulator (USA, Europe).zip
desc: „Leaderboard Golf“ marks the beginning of Access' long line of golf simulations. The shot starts by holding the fire button to set the power, then pressing it again to apply a hook or slice if needed. The greens are sloped, so this should be taken into account when planning shots. Four 18-hole courses are available, which can be combined freely in a 4-round match with up to four players. There are three difficulty levels: novices only need to choose the right speed, direction, and club. Amateurs must also time their shot precisely to control the ball's curve—conventional golf wisdom suggests eliminating unwanted spin before intentionally applying it—while the professional level introduces wind fluctuations as an additional challenge.

name: Learning with Leeper
desc: In Learning with Leeper you pick from four learning games by moving Leeper to an icon. In one, you match bones to the number of dogs on the side. In another, you identify matching symbols, letters, shapes, or words from a selection. If you answer incorrectly, the correct one briefly flashes. The third game lets you explore a random maze with the help of a caterpillar. The fourth allows you to color scenes like houses, mountains, or people – no pressure, just fun.

name: Linking Logic
desc: Linking Logic is an educational game where children guide Buddy or Betty through a five-story building from top to bottom. With help from Billie the Bird, you place bridges, walls, ladders, and springs to create a safe path. No gaps are allowed, and all patterned tiles must be collected along the way. If a tile is missing when the child reaches the ground floor, the game is lost. Each level brings new challenges that encourage logical thinking, planning, and pattern recognition – all in a playful format designed for imaginative learning.

name: Lode Runner
desc:
The Bungeling Empire has stolen a huge cache of gold from its rightful owners, and your mission is to infiltrate its treasury and recapture it. This entails progressing through 150 screens of platforms, ladders and ropes.
The Empire has sent robotic guards down to protect the gold, and contact with any of these will cost you a life. Your method of escaping them is to press fire to dig a hole in their line of movement, thus causing them to fall in briefly, allowing you to move across the gap safely. Once all the gold has been collected, a ladder allowing you to move onto the next screen is added. Completing these screens often requires forward planning and precision.
This was one of the earliest games to include a level editor, allowing the creation of new level designs with no programming skill.

name: Logic Levels
desc: A ball is dropped at the top of a multi-level maze and must successfully navigate to the slot at the bottom of the puzzle. The player controls a hand icon that can be used to place a variety of tools in the maze, including bridges, vertical walls that prevent the ball from moving, and jumpers that push the ball up a level. Spray cans can change the color of the ball to win prizes of the same color. The player can control when to activate these items while the ball is rolling. As the ball rolls, it loses energy and the player must reach the end with energy intact. Energy is obtained by changing to the correct color and moving across energy fields. There are holes in the maze and if the ball rolls sideways, the level is lost. The levels are getting more and more difficult.

name: Lunar Leeper
desc: “Lunar Leeper” challenges you to rescue hostages on the surface and safely bring them to your ship while avoiding moon leapers that attempt to capture you or the hostages. If you approach a hostage while a leaper is nearby, the leaper will rush toward the hostage unless it is killed. If a leaper captures you, you lose a life. You can shoot the leapers, but only when they are not on the surface, and your ammunition is limited. Additionally, your fuel supply is finite, requiring you to refuel at a station when it runs low. Between levels, you enter a cave where you must locate and destroy a massive floating object to progress to the next, more challenging level.
