name: Mario's Brewery
desc: Mario's Brewery is a Donkey Kong clone. Instead of trying to defeat Donkey Kong and save his girlfriend, the player must instead avoid a rampaging soda machine. The player controls Mario, who can move sideways, climb ladders and jump over hazards. The player has 3 lives and loses a life when colliding with a hazard.

name: MasterType
desc: MasterType blends typing practice with fast-paced space defense. As a wizard, you protect a command ship at the center of the screen while missiles approach from every corner, each labeled with a word. Only by typing the words quickly and accurately can you repel the incoming threats. The ship is divided into sections – if one area is hit twice, the entire vessel explodes and the game ends. A beginner mode and adjustable words-per-minute target let you tailor the challenge – turning keyboard training into an exciting race against time.

name: Match Point
desc: Match Point brings tennis to the screen with full rules and a pleasantly lively presentation. You fight your way through quarter-finals, semi-finals, or the final, play longer matches, and have to use ball speed, direction, and spin cleverly to outplay your opponent. Small details such as spectators following the action, ball boys, and the shadow beneath the ball add extra atmosphere to each rally. The result is a polished tennis game that effectively combines sporting precision, tournament flair, and exciting exchanges.

name: Match Point
desc: Match Point brings tennis to the screen with full rules and a pleasantly lively presentation. You fight your way through quarter-finals, semi-finals, or the final, play longer matches, and have to use ball speed, direction, and spin cleverly to outplay your opponent. Small details such as spectators following the action, ball boys, and the shadow beneath the ball add extra atmosphere to each rally. The result is a polished tennis game that effectively combines sporting precision, tournament flair, and exciting exchanges.

name: Math Mileage
desc: Math Mileage is an educational game that mixed racing with mathematics. The player is driving a formula racing car from a top down perspective and has to reach a goal in the shortest and fastest way. The road has a number of forks and over each branch there is a sign with a mathematical operation which changes the mileage when driving through. For example if the goal distance is 20 miles the player has to choose two +10 branches. The goal has to be reached exactly and if the mileage is larger than the goal the player will be rerouted and need to go through a branch that either subtracts or divides the mileage.

name: Maze Master
desc: "Maze Master" is an adventure game in which the player creates a party of three warriors or wizards and explores a labyrinth to defeat monsters and gain experience. The goal is to reach the Balrog and break through its magical aura. The labyrinth is displayed in a 3D wireframe view and can be navigated using either the keyboard or joystick. A self-drawn map helps with orientation. Monsters such as dwarves, goblins, and thieves become stronger as deeper levels are reached. Defeated enemies provide gold and experience, which can be used to acquire better weapons, armor, and magical items.

name: Mega Fun
desc: Mega Fun offers three different gaming experiences, each with unique challenges. In „Ten Pin Bowling,“ players must execute precise throws to knock down as many pins as possible and achieve a high score. „Meteor Runner“ tests quick reflexes as obstacles must be avoided and power-ups collected to progress through the level. „Vortex“ requires strategic thinking, where players must analyze patterns and movements to reach their goal.

name: Memory Manor
desc: In “Memory Manor,” children help Wee Willie wash windows before the water supply runs out. They must remember which windows to clean, such as those with cats, flowers, or birds, while avoiding windows with grim faces, as these consume too much water. Rain complicates the task by smudging the windows, making it harder to remember. The game promotes memory training, concentration, and careful planning.

name: Miner 2049er
desc: You play the part of Bounty Bob, and it is your mission to explore every inch of an abandoned mine. As you walk over floor sections in the mine, the floor will change color. When all of the floor sections have been changed in color, you can move on to the next, more challenging level. To reach all of the floor sections, you will need to figure out how to get there! You can jump (be careful not to fall too far though, or you will be squished), climb up and down ladders, and use different transportation devices that can be found on the levels (such as an elevator, slides, a springboard, or a canon!)

name: Minnesota Fat's Pool Challenger
desc: "Minnesota Fats' Pool Challenge", also known as "Hustler," offers a top-down view of the billiard table and allows for different playstyles. Using a joystick and key commands, players can shoot balls, break, or bank the cue ball against an opponent or the table itself. The six available modes include pocketing any ball into any pocket, potting balls in a specific order, sinking a designated ball into a chosen pocket, scoring points by potting balls in marked pockets, a variant with fewer balls, and a mode where players must play both the lowest and highest numbered balls.

name: Mole Attack
desc: Mole Attack is a classic reaction game where moles pop up from nine holes, and you have 60 seconds to whack them with your hammer. You need to react quickly, moving the hammer with either the joystick or keyboard to strike at the right spot and drive the moles back. Every hit scores points, and only lightning-fast timing will let you beat the high score.

name: Money Wars
desc: “Money Wars” puts you in the role of a robber who must grab money bags and return them safely – all while dodging deadly arrows raining down from above. Played from a side view, you move from the left edge to the money on the right, then back again. Three brick barricades offer temporary cover, but they take damage and eventually disappear. You have two special abilities: one increases speed, the other creates a force field that destroys arrows – both consume energy, and unused energy grants bonus points. A new money bag appears after each delivery, and every fifth one brings you to a new level. The game ends when all three lives are lost.

name: Moon Dust
desc: “Moon Dust” challenges you to cover a porthole at the center of the screen with something called “moon juice”. You control the astronaut Jose Skrjabin, who drops a seed square and then moves in arcing paths across the screen to spread the juice by crossing over the seed. Flight patterns emerge from Jose and from spherical ships you must avoid – and as the moon juice spreads and leaves trails, the music shifts dynamically based on a generative algorithm. Points are awarded after each level using an algorithmic system – and if you score high enough, you'll earn more seeds.

name: Moon Patrol
desc: Moon Patrol puts you in command of a lunar rover speeding across the rugged surface of the Moon. As you race from one base to another, you must jump over craters, dodge rocks, and shoot down alien ships attacking from above and ahead. Each segment of the journey is marked with letters from A to Z as checkpoints – reaching each stage in time earns you valuable bonuses. Only sharp reflexes and perfect timing will get you safely to the finish.

name: Motor Mania
desc: Motor Mania puts you behind the wheel of a racing car in a vertically scrolling top-down drive where your goal is to cover as many miles as possible. You control your speed up to 80 mph, brake, and steer left or right across motorways, country roads, and dirt tracks while avoiding other drivers and the road edges – as every collision costs one of your five lives. At the same time, you monitor your speedometer, fuel gauge, and battery power, since both fuel and generator levels decrease as you travel. Hazards such as potholes, falling rocks, crossroads traffic, broken glass, and logs affect steering, tires, and radiator performance. Only occasional gas stations allow you to refuel and repair your car – a demanding driving challenge where reflexes, awareness, and smart resource management determine your record distance.

name: Mountain King
desc: “Mountain King” takes you deep into a mysterious diamond mine where you climb across dark platforms with a flashlight, collect diamonds, uncover hidden spirits and ultimately retrieve the crown of the mountain king – but only if you make it back to the surface in time, without bats stealing the crown or falling victim to the spider's web below, will you become the true king of the mountain.

name: Movie Musical Madness
file: Movie Musical Madness Starring the Jazz Scats (USA, Europe).zip
desc: Featuring the musical band the Jazz Scats, the player creates a music video for the band. The player chooses a band member, and then places a variety of props on the scene. The player can choose from a variety of musical scores to accompany the scene. The player then can move their chosen character throughout the animated scene as music plays. Items, props, and music are chosen from a number of menus represented by dots at the top and bottom of the screen. Movies can be saved and reviewed at a later date.

name: Mr. Cool
desc: „Mr. Cool“ is a vibrant action game where you hop across a pyramid-shaped field to change the platform colors to a target hue. You must avoid enemies approaching from the sides and above while completing your color transformation. The game features 15 increasingly difficult rounds – after which it restarts at a faster pace. Though inspired by „Q*Bert“, this game introduces new elements and a sharper challenge, making it more than just a clone.

name: Mr. TNT
desc: Mr. TNT puts you in control of a blobby character navigating a grid to collect sixteen sticks of dynamite. At the same time, burning fuses move across the board – touching one means instant explosion. The twist is that every tile crossed disappears permanently, making careful route planning essential to avoid trapping yourself. Fuses can even eliminate themselves this way. A level ends when all dynamite is collected or all fuses have burned out – then a new grid layout presents fresh challenges and more scoring opportunities.

name: Ms. Pac-Man
desc: In 1982, a sequel to the incredibly popular Pac-Man was introduced in the form of his girlfriend, Ms. Pac-Man. This sequel continued on the "eat the dots/avoid the ghosts" gameplay of the original game, but added new features to keep the title fresh. Like her boyfriend, Ms. Pac-Man attempts to clear four various and challenging mazes filled with dots and ever-moving bouncing fruit while avoiding Inky, Blinky, Pinky and Sue, each with their own personalities and tactics. One touch from any of these ghosts means a loss of life for Ms. Pac-Man. Ms. Pac-Man can turn the tables on her pursuers by eating one of the four Energizers located within the maze. During this time, the ghosts turn blue, and Ms. Pac-Man can eat them for bonus points (ranging from 200, 400, 800 and 1600, progressively). The Energizer power only lasts for a limited amount of time, as the ghost's eyes float back to their center box, and regenerate to chase after Ms. Pac-Man again.

name: Music Machine
desc: "Music Machine" is a music program for the Commodore 64. It allows the user to turn the C64 into a musical instrument by using the keyboard as a synthesizer. The program offers various functions such as the selection of octaves, waveforms and effects as well as rhythm accompaniment. The user manual describes in detail how to use the various functions and settings.

name: Mystic Mansion
desc: Mystic Mansion (aka Castle Hassle) lets you explore a sprawling haunted house filled with many rooms, where you take on the role of a small ghost searching for hidden treasures. Your objective is to collect as many valuables as possible while fending off enemies, solving puzzles and using room names as subtle clues. Alongside versatile combat options, you can transform into useful objects to overcome specific obstacles. Time pressure, limited lives and rising demands make careful planning essential – playful, challenging and driven by exploration and creativity.

name: Myth : History in the Making
desc: Myth: History in the Making is an action-packed adventure that takes you through mythological locations such as the Underworld, Egyptian pyramids, and ancient Greece. In each level, you must collect a magical orb to proceed. You'll face enemies like skeletons, demons, mummies, vikings, and more, using weapons such as a sword, fireballs, and a gun. Each stage ends with a mythical boss fight, including Medusa, Thor, and the Hydra. To solve puzzles, you must use specific objects in the right locations – like throwing skulls into fire to summon monsters or choosing the correct weapon for each enemy. Myth blends combat, platforming, and puzzle-solving with a touch of classical mythology.

name: Narco Police
desc: Narco Police places you in a future where drug lords rule the world and you must lead three elite squads on a dangerous mission. Your teams start at the edge of an underground tunnel network, through which you must tactically guide them to ultimately demolish a drug factory. The loadout is predefined but can be customized with different types of ammunition, rockets, explosives, first aid kits, and armor. Controlling the commander of each squad and switching between them, you can also use computer terminals to disable automated defenses and cameras.

name: Navy Seals
desc: Navy Seals puts you in control of a team of elite American fighters on a mission to destroy missiles stolen by terrorists. To eliminate the threat, you must plant bombs next to the missiles and escape before they detonate. Along the way, you'll face numerous enemies and collect more powerful weapons—details that stray from the film but suit the gameplay. While mostly side-scrolling, the levels also extend vertically beyond the visible screen, adding an extra layer of spatial challenge.

name: Nova Blast
desc: In Nova Blast, you pilot a spaceship to protect four cities from air and ground attacks. Each city has a shield that can absorb one hit – a second hit will destroy it. You can fire lasers forward and drop bombs downward while absorbing energy from tanks to generate temporary shields for vulnerable cities. Your ship can take up to ten hits per round. If all cities are destroyed or your ship takes too much damage, the mission fails.

name: Number Nabber / Shape Grabber
desc: Number Nabber / Shape Grabber is an educational game where you control a character with a long tongue that burrows underground to grab numbers, shapes, or operations. The goal is to complete math problems or match shapes shown at the top of the screen. Once both sides match, you eat an equals sign to complete the task. A small monster roams the screen – if it touches you, you're sent back to the center. There are four levels of difficulty.

name: Number Tumbler
desc: „Number Tumbler“ is an educational game that enhances math skills. The player controls a creature called Wumblechum, which jumps across a network of cups containing dice with numbers or symbols. The goal is to reach target numbers by adding, subtracting, multiplying, or dividing numbers through jumps on operation symbols. Once a target number is reached, the counter resets and a new task begins. The game can be played alone in solitaire mode, against an AI opponent, or with a second player, either simultaneously or alternately.

name: Oil's Well
desc: In Oil's Well you control a drilling arm that extends deep into the earth to extract as much oil as possible. As you reach further down, dangerous creatures lurk in the tunnels, and one touch of them on your drilling arm costs you a life. To survive, you must retract your arm quickly and plan your path carefully. The goal is to mine all the oil reserves and fill your pockets without being caught by the monsters.

name: Omega Race
desc: Omega Race puts you in the cockpit of a spaceship fighting against enemy droid ships. These leave behind mines that must be destroyed before they become a danger. The challenge peaks when the last ship of a wave attacks in a spiraling pattern. Your goal is to score as many points as possible and survive for as long as you can, as the game has no set ending. Mastery of movement is essential: your ship is controlled by rotation and thrust, and can only be slowed with reverse thrust – preventing you from firing at the same time. Hitting the screen edge causes a force wall to rebound you unpredictably, forcing you to quickly regain control to avoid crashing into enemy ships.

name: Omega Race (MAX)
desc: Omega Race puts you in the cockpit of a spaceship fighting against enemy droid ships. These leave behind mines that must be destroyed before they become a danger. The challenge peaks when the last ship of a wave attacks in a spiraling pattern. Your goal is to score as many points as possible and survive for as long as you can, as the game has no set ending. Mastery of movement is essential: your ship is controlled by rotation and thrust, and can only be slowed with reverse thrust – preventing you from firing at the same time. Hitting the screen edge causes a force wall to rebound you unpredictably, forcing you to quickly regain control to avoid crashing into enemy ships.

name: Pac-Man
desc: One of the most popular and influential games of the 1980's, Pac-Man stars a little, yellow dot-muncher who works his way around to clear a maze of the various dots and fruit which inhabit the board. Pac-Man's goal is continually challenged by four ghosts: The shy blue ghost Bashful (Inky), the trailing red ghost Shadow (Blinky), the fast pink ghost Speedy (Pinky), and the forgetful orange ghost Pokey (Clyde). One touch from any of these ghosts means a loss of life for Pac-Man. Pac-Man can turn the tables on his pursuers by eating of the four Energizers located within the maze.  During this time, the ghosts turn blue, and Pac-Man can eat them for bonus points.  This only lasts for a limited amount of time, as the ghost's eyes float back to their center box, and regenerate to chase after Pac-Man again. Survive a few rounds of gameplay, and be treated to humorous intermissions between Pac-Man and the ghosts.

name: Paint Brush
desc: In Paint Brush you can freely draw on the screen and create simple pictures. The program works as a painting tool that lets you make shapes, lines and small designs. There is no fixed gameplay objective, as the focus is on creativity and experimentation. Paint Brush is therefore mainly suited for sketching, painting and creating your own small graphics.

name: Pancho
desc: Pancho hops across platforms in an isometric view, coloring tiles just by landing on them. A wild Muncher chases him, costing a life on contact. A bouncing bean resets tiles but can be caught. Pancho starts each level on one of two flying carpets that offer safety – the Muncher can't reach them. Pressing fire teleports him to a carpet, but only four times per level.

name: Pang
desc: In Pang you face bouncing balls that move unpredictably through each level, constantly putting you under pressure – your goal is to destroy them by shooting upward. Larger balls split into smaller ones until they disappear completely, while obstacles often block your path and require careful strategy. You move through the stages using ladders but cannot jump, making positioning crucial. Various power-ups can help at the right moment – stronger weapons, time freezes, or explosive tools can turn the tide, but only if used wisely. As you progress, the challenge increases, demanding faster reactions and better timing.

name: Park Patrol
desc: In Park Patrol you take on the role of a dedicated park ranger trying to restore order in a nature reserve overrun by careless visitors – trash is scattered everywhere and even rare wildlife is put at risk. You move across land and water, collecting litter and stepping in when swimmers get into trouble. At the same time, you must watch out for curious animals and keep an eye on your energy, as running out of food quickly ends your efforts. Your supplies aren't safe either, since hungry ants are eager to steal them. The more efficiently you work, the more points you earn – but only with awareness and good time management can you stay in control of this chaotic mission.

name: Pastfinder
desc:
By the year 8878 A.D., exploration had become a thing of the past.
Looking into the past. Searching it. Unearthing its mysteries and uncovering its adventures. The Ruling Council had bestowed this critical task to an elite group of stellar explorers. Known simply as, Pastfinders.
To join their ranks, one must possess the stamina to search hundreds of uncharted lands. The knowledge to select only the proper tools for survival. The ability to dissect complex maps. And, the unending desire to live dangerously.
Membership is now open to you.

name: Peanut Butter Panic
desc: In Peanut Butter Panic you team up with another player to create sandwiches and keep going. You collect stars to power the machine and use coordinated jumps to reach higher areas. Cooperation is key, as working together lets you launch each other to greater heights and progress more efficiently. At the same time, you must watch out for hazards that can undo your progress. A unique experience that blends teamwork, timing, and quick reactions.

name: Pinball Spectacular
desc: Pinball Spectacular delivers a quirky mix of pinball and breakout on a retro-styled digital table. Using paddle controls, you launch a square-cut ball across bumpers, logos, target letters, and spinners, trying to score big before your three balls run out. Side traps and a timed ball barrier add extra unpredictability. And when idle, the game puts on a little demo show for you.

name: Pipes
desc: Pipes challenges you to design a working water supply network for a neighborhood. With a limited budget, you must find the shortest and most efficient way to connect houses to the system by choosing the right pipe types and placing them wisely. Every decision matters, as mistakes cost money and complicate progress – the more houses you aim to connect, the tougher the challenge becomes and the more careful planning is required.

name: Pitfall II : Lost Caverns
desc: “Pitfall II: Lost Caverns” takes Pitfall Harry deep into the Andes, where he searches for the legendary Raj diamond, his niece Rhonda, her cat Quickclaw, and hidden treasures. But the maze-like caverns are full of dangers: poisonous frogs, eels, scorpions, bats, and more make every move critical. Unlike its predecessor, the game features checkpoints – red crosses that send Harry back when he fails, reducing his score in the process. That score also serves as an energy reserve, and if it hits zero, the game ends. Smart exploration and collecting gold bars not only boosts your score but also helps you endure the long journey through the lost caverns.

name: Pitfall!
desc: “Pitfall!” is a classic platform adventure where you play as Pitfall Harry on a jungle quest for treasure. Gold bars, silver, money bags, and diamond rings are waiting to be collected – but the path is filled with danger. Rolling logs and falls cost points, while scorpions, alligators, snakes, fires, swamps, and bottomless pits will cost you a life. With only 20 minutes on the clock, you'll need skill and timing to gather all the treasures – if you can survive that long.

name: Pitstop
desc: Pitstop combines high-speed racing with an extra twist that gives the game its distinctive character: you not only have to drive fast, but also keep an eye on tire wear and fuel so you know exactly when to head into the pits. A large part of the tension comes from those pit stops, because you control the pit crew yourself and every second matters while the race keeps going around you. That blend of speed on the track, tactical timing, and frantic pit work gives the game a lively and unusually engaging appeal.

name: Pole Position
desc: Pole Position puts you in control of a Formula 1 car, where you first must prove yourself in a qualifying lap. Only by finishing within the time limit will you secure a spot in the Grand Prix – the faster your lap, the better your starting position and the higher your bonus. Once the race begins, you compete not only against rival cars but also against the relentless race timer. Every car you pass earns extra points, along with distance bonuses. Fail to reach the checkpoint in time and it's game over – but cross the finish line and you'll be rewarded with valuable bonus points for remaining time and overall performance.

name: Popeye
desc: Popeye is a conversion of the arcade action/platform game. As Popeye, you are trying to win Olive Oyl's love! She is at the top of the screen dropping tokens of her love, and you need to collect them before they hit the ground. After you have collected the required number of items, you can move on to the next, more difficult level. There are many obstacles trying to stop you from completing your task, though! Brutus wanders around the screen and is constantly trying to catch you. If you collect a can of spinach, you can temporarily knock him out, otherwise Brutus will knock you out. Other objects such as bottles or birds are also flying around the screen and will cause you to lose one of your lives if you are hit. Each level features a different layout of platforms and ladders, and will have you collecting different items as they float towards the bottom of the screen!

name: Power Play 64
file: MicroProse Soccer + Rick Dangerous + Stunt Car Racer (Europe) (Power Play).zip
desc: Power Play 64 bundles three well-known titles into a single cartridge, giving you a compact mix of variety. You can jump effortlessly between Microprose Soccer, Rick Dangerous and Stunt Car Racer, all ready to play without swapping disks or waiting for loads. The collection feels like a small best-of that offers three distinct experiences at once and shows why this cartridge found its way into players' hands around the world.

name: Princess and the Frog
desc: In Princess and the Frog you play a love-struck frog on a daring journey to the princess's castle. First you must cross a road crowded with galloping knights, then brave the castle moat teeming with snakes and alligators. The gators are especially treacherous, diving without warning and dragging you under if you're riding on their backs. Only precise timing and quick reflexes will get you safely to the castle – where true love turns you into a handsome prince.

name: Q*bert
desc: Qbert brings classic arcade action to your screen, challenging you to transform a pyramid into the target color by hopping across its tiles. Each jump changes a tile, but in later levels you'll need to step on tiles multiple times – or avoid doing so too often. All the while, enemies such as Coily the snake, Slick, Sam, and falling balls try to stop you. Fortunately, floating discs at the pyramid's edge can save you – leap onto one at the right moment and Qbert is carried safely back to the top while Coily plunges off the board.

name: Rack 'em Up!
desc: Rack 'em Up! lets you enjoy different pool variations, including eight-ball, nine-ball, rotation, and straight pool. Each version comes with its own rules and style of play, ensuring variety and challenge. You position the cue ball, choose your aim, shot direction, speed, and spin to sink balls as accurately as possible. The game captures the feel of a classic pool hall, inviting you to test your skills at the virtual table.

name: Radar Rat Race
desc:
Radar Rat Race takes the gameplay of Rally X and puts it into a rodent context. You control a rat, who must grab all the pieces of cheese in a maze, and flee from all the other rats. Once you reach a barrier in the maze, you are automatically rotated, but you can always manually change direction.
There are red ones who chase after you, and black ones who are activated when you get close to them - both types kill you on contact. When they are close, you can activate a Star Screen to block them off.
The Radar of the title is on the right of the screen, and shows you where each piece of cheese is, although the actual maze is not illuminated, so your next snack might be further away than you think.

name: Ranch
desc: Ranch lets you create and animate your own Wild West scenes – with cowboys, animals, buildings, and more. Start with a blank screen, then place, color, move, and animate characters and objects however you like. Whether it's a nighttime campfire, a cattle roundup, or a stagecoach ambush, the only limit is your imagination. A creative learning game for kids ages 5 to 10 that encourages visual thinking and interactive storytelling.

name: Rechtschreiblowe, Der - Fit In Rechtschreibung - 3.-4. Schuljahr
file: Rechtschreiblowe, Der - Fit in Rechtschreibung - 3.-4. Schuljahr (Germany).zip
desc: Der Rechtschreiblöwe: Fit in der Rechtschreibung (3rd/4th grade) is an educational program for the Commodore 64, designed especially for elementary school children. Through a variety of exercises, it teaches correct spelling and builds language skills in a playful way. Typical tasks involve filling in missing letters or choosing the correct spelling of words. A little lion mascot accompanies you through the lessons. The goal is to help children gain confidence in their spelling while keeping the learning process fun.

name: Retro Ball
desc: Retro Ball is a head-to-head digital air hockey game for two players. Each controls a paddle, aiming to score by hitting the puck into the opponent's goal. A coin toss decides who starts, and also resets play if the puck gets stuck on the center line. Matches are timed, and the player with the most goals wins. You can choose between a fast or slow puck to adjust the game's speed and intensity.

name: River Raid
desc: River Raid puts you in a jet flying along a hostile river as you destroy key bridges and fight through heavy defenses. Enemy vehicles, ships and aircraft appear continuously, forcing precise maneuvering between narrow banks and incoming fire. At the same time, fuel management is essential, requiring careful passes over supply points to keep the mission alive. The blend of navigation, shooting and resource awareness creates a focused action experience where mistakes carry immediate consequences.

name: Road Race
desc: Road Race is a fast-paced night racing game where your goal is to score as many points as possible within 90 seconds by passing checkpoints. Crashing into road edges, obstacles, or oncoming cars will cost you time and speed. Choose from four tracks – beginner, pro, expert, or random, with the latter changing every time and resisting memorization. Game options include infinite time and honking alerts for incoming cars.

name: Robocop 2
desc: RoboCop 2 is a mission-based platform game. Missions have various objectives, such as destroying nukes or killing all the enemies. If you didn't destroy/kill enough, you'll be transported to a training mission, which is a first-person perspective shoot 'em up. Should you also fail the training, you must go to the beginning of the previous mission. Successfully completed mission or enough points scored by training allow you to proceed to the next stage. Unlike in the first RoboCop, there's no time limit, and you are able to jump.

name: Robocop 3
desc: RoboCop 3 is a side-scrolling platform shooter. You get missions (such as rescuing your colleagues who are being kept hostages), which are divided into several smaller levels. The levels usually consist of several platforms, and are heavily populated by enemies who shoot at you. You can gather special repair kits, which will be used to restore your health after you've completed a level. "RoboCop 3" is more of a shooter than its predecessors, having more and tougher enemies.

name: Robotron : 2084
desc: You are a mutant human, who by some freak of nature has the ability to shoot energy pulses from his body in eight different directions! Your job is simple: save humanity from their own creation -- the ROBOTRONS! The gameplay is pretty unique for the time. You can move and fire in any of eight directions. You get thrown in a room with various evil baddies strewn about, you've got to kill all the robots while at the same time finding some way to grab humans and avoid death.

name: Rootin' Tootin'
desc: In "Rootin' Tootin'," you control a tuba navigating a maze of musical staves, collecting notes while being pursued by various instruments. These instruments — such as cymbals, triangles, guitars, and pianos — each have unique abilities to hinder your progress. Collected notes can be used as weapons, destroying enemies in their path. Additionally, you can become intangible for a short time, making you invulnerable but unable to collect notes. Skill and timing are crucial to mastering this musical challenge.

name: Sammy Lightfoot
desc: Go through three levels jumping over obstacles that get in your way. Use trampolines and swings to get to hard-to-reach places and avoid hazards or falling down gaps. Get to the top of the screen in order to proceed to the next level. Once three levels are completed, the game restarts with increased difficulty. Before you start the game, you can access the options screen which lets you customize the screen to include another player, turn off the sound or the scene music, or let either player start at any particular level.

name: Satan
desc:
Three magic scrolls must be found in the first part of the scrolling hack 'n' slash game, before you can make the journey to defeat your foes and rescue the other wizards in the second part. As with so many Dinamic games, the two parts are loaded separately, but the second can't be accessed until a password (provided at the end of part one) is input.
Contact with the enemies en route (which are mostly mutant demons) drains your limited energy, and you are also working against a time limit on each section. As well as your magical powers (which are stronger in part two), you can collect swords to attack, as well as lightning bolts which can be collected to destroy all enemies on screen. In part two vanquished foes release coins, which can be spent at shop sections on rechargers, shields and teleporters amongst other things.

name: Save New York
desc: "Save New York" is a shooter where the action takes place on one screen only; but there are lots of things going on on that screen. You see blue sky over skyscrapers and subway tunnels beneath. New York is under attack, and you are a pilot in a little blue airplane who must save it from destruction caused by aliens. At the beginning of each stage, the aliens begin to drop from the sky. Your goal is to cruise around in your plane and to shoot them, preferably before they descend on a building, because then they will begin to crush it until it is destroyed completely.

name: Sea Horse Hide'n Seek
desc: In Sea Horse Hide'n Seek you guide a group of playful seahorses through a colorful underwater world. With patience and a sharp eye, you lead them safely across the coral reef as they constantly change colors to hide from danger. The lagoon is full of surprises – timing and observation are key to bringing them safely to the old shipwreck. A calm yet captivating adventure set in the shimmering depths of the sea.

name: Sea Speller
desc: In Sea Speller you control a dolphin helping a submarine reach the ocean floor before it runs out of air. You do this by collecting letter sponges and combining them into words shown on the sub's billboard. Each completed word lights up a panel on the submarine until it descends to the next level, where longer words are required. The faster you play, the higher the score, with leftover air awarding extra bonus points. Clever combinations can form multiple words at once, while special “magic words” related to the sea instantly advance you to the next stage. In addition to single-player mode, there's also a cooperative two-player option where turns are taken to achieve a shared score.

name: Sea Wolf
desc: You are the commander...and Sea Wolf puts you in charge of sinking and destroying all enemy ships. You are armed with 4 torpedoes which will reload after you fire. Your primary targets are the small P.T. Boats which travel quickly through the water. You can choose the length of your playing time. Game times vary from 1 to 9 minutes in 1 minute intervals.

name: Seafox
desc: In Seafox you pilot a submarine through treacherous waters filled with enemies above and below. You attack with torpedoes fired forward or upward, but ammo and fuel are limited. Only the green supply ship and its loyal dolphin can save you in time. Destroyers drop deadly depth charges, enemy subs hunt you down, and some ships even reflect your own torpedoes back at you. Skill, timing, and a calm mind will determine whether you rise as a hunter or sink as a wreck.

name: Serpentine
desc: In Serpentine you control a segmented snake in a maze, trying to outlast and devour three enemy snakes. You can only bite the tail of snakes longer than you – head collisions are fatal. Bite off segments to shrink them until you can consume them whole. Eat frogs to grow, and be mindful of eggs left behind – yours grant extra lives, enemy eggs hatch more foes. You can eat eggs to stop that. Each new level brings a different maze and tougher enemy snakes, ramping up the challenge.

name: Sesame Street : Letter-Go-Round
desc: Sesame Street: Letter-Go-Round invites young players into a cheerful learning carousel where they catch letters, recognize them and form simple words. The Ferris wheel spins with new letters in every bucket, while a Muppet pet selects the target letter or word beforehand. You pick the right match – sometimes uppercase, sometimes lowercase, sometimes mixed or even as a missing part of a small word. It's playful, easy to grasp and tailored perfectly to children aged three to four, helping them take their first steps in letter recognition and basic word building.

name: Shadow of the Beast
desc: Shadow of the Beast tells the dark story of Aarbron, kidnapped as a child and transformed into a servant of the Beast Lord until a tragic encounter with his father awakens buried memories and sets him on a path of revenge. You battle through hostile environments filled with creatures, traps and interconnected areas where keys, triggers and hidden items shape progression. Combat options are intentionally limited, making precise timing and pattern recognition essential, while many hazards must be avoided rather than destroyed. Its rich atmosphere, detailed environments and demanding difficulty create an intense adventure that rewards persistence and careful observation.

name: Simons' Basic
desc: Simons' BASIC is an extension of BASIC V2 on the C64, developed by the then 16-year-old David Simons. It adds 114 additional commands, significantly simplifying and enhancing programming on the C64. Released in 1983 by D.S. Software through Commodore UK, the extension provided users with new tools to create more complex programs more efficiently.

name: Solar Fox
desc: Solar Fox puts you in control of a spaceship racing through a grid of solar cells that must be collected to progress. Two sentinels patrol the edges, launching deadly fireballs you can only dodge – your ship is unarmed. You can fly at two speeds to adapt to the chaos. If you clear the grid before the “skip-a-rack” timer runs out, you'll earn bonus points and jump ahead a level. The game ends when all your ships are destroyed.

name: Song Maker
desc: Song Maker lets you explore the basics of music in a playful way. Charming characters guide you through notes, rhythms, and simple melodies. You can create your own little songs and listen to them afterward. Designed for children around ages 4 to 8, it turns learning about music into a cheerful adventure.

name: Space Action
desc: Space Action is a horizontally scrolling shooter for the Commodore 64. The game bears strong similarities to the arcade classic "Defender" and challenges the player to hold their own against waves of enemies while navigating a continuously scrolling game world. In "Space Action" the player takes control of a spaceship flying through enemy territory. The goal is to shoot down enemy ships and threats while protecting your own spaceship from damage. The gameplay relies on a mixture of fast action and skillful maneuvering, as the player must constantly move between attack and defense. The controls are responsive, which is crucial for dodging projectiles and targeting enemies.

name: Space Gun
desc: Space Gun throws you into a desperate rescue mission at the far edge of the galaxy. Humans had only encountered harmless life – until creatures appeared that see ships and crews as ideal prey. You lead a rescue team, pushing through dark, twisting corridors and facing wave after wave of vicious monsters. Every survivor you find and every bit of extra ammo gives you a spark of hope as you advance and try to contain the nightmare before it spreads.

name: Space Ric-o-shay
desc: Space Ric-o-shay drops you into a sudden assault on an alien mothership above a remote outpost. You control a small ship, move sideways and fire upward while a massive enemy patrols horizontally and shoots back. Successful hits break the ship into segments that create new tactical options – destroyed fragments turn into bumpers that deflect future objects. Precision and timing are key, as collisions cost lives and the tension rises with each appearance of a larger foe.

name: Space Shuttle : A Journey into Space
file: Space Shuttle - A Journey into Space (USA, Europe).zip
desc: “Space Shuttle: A Journey into Space” is a simulation where you take on the role of the Discovery's pilot – completing a full mission. The objective is to launch the shuttle, establish a stable orbit, open the cargo bay doors, retrieve a satellite for repairs, and successfully land while using as little fuel as possible. After each completed mission, the difficulty increases – with the satellite's trajectory becoming more erratic. The game is played from a first-person perspective inside the cockpit, allowing full control over systems from the engines to the cargo bay doors. At the end, a ranking is given based on the number of successful dockings and fuel consumption.

name: Speed/Bingo Math
desc: "Speed Math & Bingo Math" is an educational game that playfully trains math skills. It offers two modes: In "Speed Math," players must solve arithmetic problems as quickly as possible to earn points. "Bingo Math" combines math with a bingo-style board, where correct answers mark spaces on the grid. The game encourages mental arithmetic and quick thinking and can be played solo or with a second player.

name: Spitball
desc: In Spitball you face a quirky duel where you move through a playfield filled with tubes and pinball-like elements while keeping an eye on your opponent. You navigate tight spaces and use well-timed attacks to take them down. At the same time, you must avoid collisions with both your rival and the environment, or your run ends instantly. The mix of movement, timing, and direct confrontation makes each round fast-paced and uniquely chaotic.

name: Spy Hunter
desc: A conversion of the arcade game, Spy Hunter is a driving action game played from an overhead point of view. Your car is equipped with machine guns to help you get past the numerous enemies out on the road (be careful not to shoot any civilians, though!) Occasionally you will come across a weapons van, and if you drive into the back of the van your car becomes equipped with a second weapon (such as smoke screen, oil slick, or missiles.) At several points the road splits and you can enter a boathouse which transforms your car into a boat temporarily. If you drive far enough the seasons change as well (watch out for icy conditions during winter!) The enemy cars will do anything to stop you, including running you off the road, firing guns from the back of a limmo, or dropping bombs from a helicopter.

name: Star Post
desc: “Star Post” is an action-packed defense game where the player must protect a base from three-dimensional invaders. The attackers approach from eight different channels, with a Superalien posing a special threat as it disrupts the display screen and spirals toward the outpost. Players can choose from three difficulty levels: Beginner, Advanced, and Hyper. With each new level, hit points are reset, but eight hits within a single round will destroy the star post. Quick reflexes and strategic skill are crucial to successfully fend off the threats.

name: Star Ranger
desc: Star Ranger stands out from typical space shooters by offering a slower, more tactical pace. Your ship can fire in two directions, but with limited frequency – making precision vital. Enemies don't just fly past; they remain on screen, actively hunting you until destroyed. Each enemy type has its own attack pattern: some rush in close, others shoot from afar or release waves of indestructible bombs. Add invisible foes, drifting asteroids, and tight corridors, and you face a challenge that rewards patience, timing, and steady nerves.

name: Star Trek : Strategic Operations Simulator
file: Star Trek - Strategic Operations Simulator (USA, Europe).zip
desc: “Star Trek: Strategic Operations Simulator” puts the player in command of the Enterprise, tasked with defending sectors against invading Klingon forces. The game switches between a tactical overhead map view and a cockpit perspective with a direct view of the action. Success depends on how well the player manages available resources – shields, photon torpedoes, and warp energy must be used wisely and replenished at starbases in time. The goal is not just to survive but to protect the Federation from losing strategic positions.

name: Star Wars : The Arcade Game
file: Star Wars - The Arcade Game (USA, Europe).zip
desc: Star Wars: The Arcade Game puts you directly in the cockpit of an X-wing, letting you experience the battle against the Empire firsthand. From a first-person perspective, you play as Luke Skywalker (“Red Five”) and face three phases: surviving waves of TIE Fighters, enduring the Death Star's surface gun turrets, and finally navigating the trench run to destroy the superweapon. You don't need to destroy every enemy, only survive long enough while managing your six shields. Once they are depleted and you take another hit, the game ends.

name: Stix
desc: Stix pits you against Kwixx, a relentless being of pure energy that destroys everything in its path. Your task is to draw lines and create force fields that seal off areas until most of the screen is secured. Once an outline is completed, the enclosed space fills with color and further restricts Kwixx, but additional threats force you to stay fast and precise. Hesitate too long or collide with hostile particles and you lose lives, increasing the pressure with every stage – a tense balance of risk, planning and speed.

name: Story Machine
desc: Story Machine invites you to experiment with language and create your own small stories. By typing simple sentences, words come to life as key nouns and verbs are instantly turned into animations. Step by step, you build short narratives, combine characters, actions and objects, and immediately see the results of your input. The focus is on creativity, expression and playful language discovery – calm, intuitive and motivating thanks to direct visual feedback.

name: Super Alien Max
desc: Super Alien is a single-screen action game and a clone of the 1979 arcade game Heiankyo Alien and was released on the Commodore VIC-20. The player moves through the maze and can place traps on the floor. If a monster goes in, it will be trapped and the player can kill it by filling the hole. Points are awarded for each monster defeated, while touching that monster results in a loss of life points. The maze is shown from the usual top view, but the characters have a side view.

name: Super Explode 5
desc: Super Explode! 5 is a graphics cartridge designed to capture, edit, and print screens, including recoloring capabilities and compatibility with nearly all color printers. It offers extensive tools for graphic editing and integrates with the Video Byte system, an affordable video digitizer that captures color images from VCRs or live cameras. In addition to its graphic features, it includes a simple disk turbo function, screen directory listings, fast file copying, and basic disk commands. However, it lacks additional features like a BASIC toolkit or comprehensive backup options. The manual, provided on disk, offers detailed technical information despite its cluttered presentation, covering topics such as split screens, file conversion, sprite manipulation, and sprite overlay. It's ideal for users seeking extensive graphic options with minimal extra functionalities.

name: Super Games
file: Colossus Chess + Silicon Syborgs + International Football (USA, Europe) (Super Games).zip
desc: Super Games is a game compilation released by Commodore on cartridge, featuring three different games. „Colossus Chess“ offers a classic chess experience with strategic depth. „Silicon Syborgs“ is a variation of „Connect Four,“ requiring tactical skill. „International Football“ delivers a dynamic soccer game with well-executed controls and engaging mechanics.

name: Super Smash
desc: “Super Smash” is a classic Breakout-style game where you use a paddle to bounce a ball against a wall of colorful blocks to earn points. If the ball hits the top of the screen, the paddle shrinks, increasing the challenge. Let the ball fall five times and it's game over. The game is controlled only via paddle in joystick port 1, providing a responsive arcade feel. Two players can take turns, and three difficulty levels – Normal, Special, and Progressive – offer options for every skill level. The game is available exclusively as a plug-in cartridge.

name: Super Zaxxon
desc: Super Zaxxon is a faster, tougher sequel to the classic arcade shooter Zaxxon. From its signature isometric view, you pilot your ship across an enemy fortress filled with gun turrets, radar stations, fuel tanks, and missile launchers. Then, you must navigate a narrow tunnel packed with enemy fighters, deadly mine layers, and floating explosives before reaching another asteroid where the fearsome Super Zaxxon dragon awaits. Compared to the original, your craft moves at a much higher speed, new enemies increase the challenge, and the outer-space segment is replaced with intense tunnel runs. Facing three Super Zaxxons instead of one, only the sharpest pilots will survive this upgraded assault.

name: Tank Wars
desc: Tank Wars is a simple single screen action game for two players that is similar to the Atari 2600 game Combat. Each player controls a tank and has to shoot down the opponent. Each kill gives the player one point and the one that first reaches ten points will win the game. The game can be played with or without barriers that offer some protection. When used the game starts with each player placing nine rectangular barriers on the battlefield.

name: Tapper
desc: Tapper is an action game where you're a beer tapper (barman) and have to serve beer to demanding customers. There are four customers, each has its own lane lengthier than the previous one, whom you have to keep at bay. If they reach the end of the lane without receiving their beer, you're a goner; if you miss one and accidentally spill beer needlessly you lose a life and should one of them throw you back the mug and you fail to catch it, you lose a life as well. Occasionally a bizarre icon will appear on one of the lines and, should you grab it, will invoke a "cabarette"-style show which will keep some of the customers occupied.

name: Tenpins
desc: Tenpins brings classic bowling to the C64 in a smooth side-view presentation. You control your bowler, line up the shot, and roll the ball to knock down as many pins as possible. Strikes and spares are scored automatically according to official bowling rules, leaving you to focus on timing and throwing technique. With each frame, the challenge builds as you aim for the perfect game and a new high score.

name: Terminator 2 : Judgment Day
file: Terminator 2 - Judgment Day + Modern Music Maker + Image System, The (Europe).zip
desc: The game consists of several actions parts linked together. All parts are different, each resembling typical games of the genre (for example: 1st level is like a side-view beat 'em up). Between each level a small cutscene from the movie is shown.

name: The Black Box
desc: In Black Box there is an 8x8 grid which contains several atoms hidden in it. Your job is to find the location of all of the atoms by projecting rays from the side of the box and observing what happens. If a ray directly hits an atom it will be absorbed. Rays that pass within one box of an atom will be reflected. After you have fired enough rays, you can venture a guess as to an atoms location. To help prevent random guessing you lose points for a ray that completely misses an atom or an incorrect guess about the atoms location, and gain points for rays that are absorbed or reflected and for a correct guess. If you get stumped you can end the game early and peek at the location of all atoms.

name: The Fourth Sarcophagus
desc: The Fourth Sarcophagus places you in a classic text adventure that relies entirely on descriptions and short commands rather than graphics. In the strange land of Hebryptia, you explore locations, gather clues and search for the pyramid where a hidden secret awaits. The beginning can feel challenging as you experiment with actions and slowly find your direction, while the limited parser demands precise wording. This simplicity creates a focused atmosphere that rewards imagination, patience and methodical exploration.

name: The Mutant Spiders
desc: “The Adventure 1: Mutant Spiders” (also known as “Commodore Adventure #1”) is a text-based adventure game where your mission is to save the world from an invasion of giant mutant spiders. You must find and destroy their eggs before they hatch and unleash chaos. But reaching their nest won't be easy – not only will the spiders fight back, but the forces of nature themselves will stand in your way. Only clear thinking, determination, and smart choices will prevent disaster.

name: The Official Frogger
desc: Frogger is a classic arcade conversion in which you must safely guide a frog across a dangerous road and a raging river to reach one of the home cells at the top of the screen. On the road, you must avoid speeding cars and trucks, while in the river, water, snakes, sinking turtles and alligators pose a deadly threat – especially their heads, which must be avoided. Only by skillfully jumping across logs, turtles and alligators can you advance. Reaching a home cell with a fly grants bonus points. Once all homes are filled, a tougher level begins.

name: The Pit
desc: The Pit sends you underground after your spaceship lands, tasking you with digging through a maze of tunnels while danger lurks everywhere. Falling rocks, creatures, traps, and corrosive hazards force careful movement and quick decisions, as every step can be the wrong one. Instead of a traditional timer, a machine slowly destroys the area around your ship, meaning staying below for too long can cut off your escape. After collecting the treasure, the most dangerous section awaits: a room with a shifting floor above a hungry monster that must be crossed at the right moment – a tense balance between risk, timing, and exploration.

name: The Tool-64
desc: The Tool-64 is a compilation disk featuring a colorful mix of games, educational titles, and utilities. Included are classics like H.E.R.O., Up'n Down II, Wor of Bemer, Tennis, and Caverns of Khafka, as well as the learning game Multiplication and the famous chatbot Eliza. The fourth program, Tool, functions as a BASIC enhancer, adding extra commands and features to simplify programming on the C64. A fascinating mix that combines action, education, and practical tools all on one disk.

name: The Visible Solar System
desc: The Visible Solar System puts you in command of a spaceship with over a billion miles of range, journeying through our Solar System. Equipped with advanced computer systems, you explore planets, gather data, and uncover fascinating cosmic phenomena. Your mission – expand knowledge and return safely to Earth.

name: Threshold
desc: Threshold is a classic shoot 'em up where you control a spaceship at the bottom of the screen and blast enemy formations at the top. The challenge comes from a limited fuel supply, which only refills after clearing several waves. On top of that, your ship's laser is prone to overheating – every shot raises the heat bar. Once it maxes out, you can't fire and must wait for it to cool down, all while your fuel keeps draining. This creates constant tension between attacking and managing your resources.

name: Timebound
desc: Timebound is an educational game where you must use your knowledge of history. Dr. Anacron has invented a time machine but is now trapped in a time loop between the year 0 and 2000. Your task is to locate Anacron and save him by using historical knowledge. The game was designed to teach and reinforce the chronology of historical events in a playful way.

name: Toki
desc: In Toki, a brave jungle warrior is turned into a monkey by an evil wizard who has kidnapped his girlfriend. To rescue her and regain his human form, Toki must fight through perilous areas like dark caves, underwater zones, fiery grottos, and icy palaces. His only weapon is his spit, which can be upgraded to fireballs or multi-shots. Items like helmets, jump boots, time extensions, extra lives, and score-boosting fruit help him survive. Toki must jump, spit, and dodge his way to save Wanda and himself.

name: Tooth Invaders
desc: Tooth Invaders puts you in control of Plaqueman, who fights the plaque germ D.K. using a toothbrush and dental floss. You must clean every tooth, energize your brush with toothpaste, and use floss between teeth. Contact with D.K. results in elimination. If decay begins, warning sounds alert you – be fast and thorough.

name: Toy Bizarre
desc: Toy Bizarre pits you against a runaway horde of toy robots inside a department store. You shut off valves to influence where new toys appear and must also watch out for sudden safety checks before Hilda catches you. The attacking figures can be jumped over or briefly stunned, but after every survived hour the chaos starts all over again. This creates a wonderfully frantic game that charmingly combines timing, awareness, and a delightfully odd premise.

name: Trashman
desc: Trashman turns the familiar maze formula into a fun garbage-collecting chase: you control a garbage truck, pick up all the trash, and bring it to the City Dump. At the same time, you have to avoid the roaming enemies, but the trash can bonuses let you briefly hunt them down yourself for extra points. With the connected edges of the playfield keeping the chase in motion, it becomes a lively score-based classic with a familiar structure and its own charmingly odd idea.

name: TSI Maze Man
desc: The player controls a Pac-Man like creature in a maze trying to eat all the pellets. Four ghosts are released from their homes, and will chase the player if approached too close. Power pellets in the corners of the screen will temporarily send the ghosts back to their homes. If the player clears a level, they advance to a more difficult challenge. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.

name: Turbo Maze Man
desc: The player controls a Pac-Man like creature in a maze trying to eat all the pellets. Four ghosts are released from their homes, and will chase the player if approached too close. Power pellets in the corners of the screen will temporarily send the ghosts back to their homes. If the player clears a level, they advance to a more difficult challenge. The player starts with 5 lives, and it's game over when all are lost.

name: Tyler's Dungeons
desc: Tyler's Dungeons throws you into a massive maze of 250 rooms spread across four levels, all connected by elevators. Your goal: to find eight precious treasures and make it out alive. But danger is everywhere – every room hides a lurking enemy that mirrors your movement, while cross traps collapse around you and snake pits spring to life without warning. One mistake means instant death and a fresh start from the beginning. Only careful planning and steady nerves will see you through the deadly depths of Tyler's Dungeons.

name: Ultrex Quadro Maze
desc: Ultrex Quadro Maze challenges you to keep track of four small mazes on screen and clear them one after another. In each section, you collect all pellets while avoiding a roaming enemy, then jump to the next maze. Randomized layouts ensure that every run feels different, while short animations add momentum between transitions. The appeal comes from balancing awareness, timing and quick reactions, as every mistake costs valuable lives.

name: Up & Add 'em
desc: In "Up & Add 'em," children learn basic mathematics in a playful way. Using colorful balloons and engaging graphics, simple arithmetic tasks are introduced to help young players aged 3 to 7 take their first steps into the world of numbers.

name: Up 'n Down
desc: Up 'n Down puts you on twisty tracks where your goal is to collect all the colored flags with your vehicle. Jumping over gaps, obstacles and other cars is essential, as well-timed landings destroy opponents and earn points. Extra items provide bonus scores, while speed is crucial – the faster you grab every flag, the greater the time reward. Later stages introduce dead ends and moving targets that demand precise timing, since a single mistake or leaving the course costs a life.

name: Up for Grabs
desc: Up for Grabs turns incoming letters into a hectic word duel where quick decisions matter just as much as a good feel for language. New letters constantly appear in the center, and you have to claim them and arrange them on your own board to form horizontal or vertical words. While you are still rearranging, the supply keeps rotating and the competition can snatch useful letters away – a clever word game where organization, speed, and strong word ideas decide the final score.

name: US Geography Series : Utah Counties Tutorial
desc: Learning the US state names and capitals not enough for you? How about identifying all the counties within Utah. Feel up to the challenge? God knows how many more of these education carts are out there, but you have any of them, let me know!

name: Viduzzles
desc: Viduzzles lets you solve classic jigsaw puzzles on your computer – with 25 or 50 pieces, and with or without outlines. First, you're shown the full image, then given an empty board and the puzzle pieces to complete it. Place the pieces and finish the puzzle as quickly as possible. Once done, a new picture awaits. A calm yet challenging game for fans of thoughtful puzzling.

name: Viking Raider
desc: In Viking Raider, you play as Lief, a Viking in Narvay where the greedy ogre Smoth has seized the throne and imprisoned Queen Dana in Castle Osk. Smoth is guarded by two large goblins. To reach him, you must buy the black key, open the throne room gate, defeat Smoth, and rescue Dana. To earn enough wealth for the key, raid the countryside for treasures and store them in your longhouse – all while fending off fierce monsters. Only clever raiding and brave fighting will restore the kingdom.

name: Vindicators
desc: “Vindicators” puts you in control of a sluggish but deadly tank, with the mission to stop the Tangent Empire from launching an invasion. Your objective is to destroy 14 enemy space stations, each divided into three sections you can tackle in any order. The action scrolls in all directions, and maneuvering your tank takes some effort – making quick dodging a challenge. Precision shooting and swift decisions are key. Throughout the levels, you collect energy stars, which can be traded after each stage for upgrades like better weapons or increased speed. Only with smart tactics and continuous enhancements can you save Earth.

name: Webster : The Word Game
desc: Webster: The Word Game is a word recognition game. The object of the game is to fill in the missing letters of an incomplete word. On each round a word will appear at the top of the screen with several letters missing. The word will slowly begin moving towards the bottom of the screen and along the bottom of the screen is the complete alphabet. The player needs to select the letters that are missing from the word before time runs out and the word reaches the bottom of the screen. Successfully completing a word earns points, but if the word reaches the bottom of the screen then the player loses a life. The game ends when all five lives are lost.

name: Wizard of Id's WizType
file: Wizard of Id's Wiztype, The (USA, Europe).zip
desc: The Wizard of Id's WizType is an edutainment title based on the comic strip created by artist Brant Parker and writer Johnny Hart. The title is designed to give keyboard novices lessons on how to improve their typing accuracy and speed.

name: Wizard of Wor
desc: In Wizard of Wor, you control a so-called Worrior through a maze filled with deadly creatures. Your goal is to score as many points as possible by shooting the monsters before they catch you. Some enemies move quickly or even turn invisible for a time. A radar at the bottom of the screen helps you locate hidden foes. Reflexes, accuracy, and spatial awareness are key to surviving the increasingly challenging waves.

name: Wizard of Wor
desc: In Wizard of Wor, you control a so-called Worrior through a maze filled with deadly creatures. Your goal is to score as many points as possible by shooting the monsters before they catch you. Some enemies move quickly or even turn invisible for a time. A radar at the bottom of the screen helps you locate hidden foes. Reflexes, accuracy, and spatial awareness are key to surviving the increasingly challenging waves.

name: Wonderboy
desc: Just when things were going great with Tom-Tom and his girlfriend Tanya, some thug of a woodland king had to kidnap her and hide her away, and Tom-Tom doesn't have a clue where. That's why he has to explore deep dark forests, cross endless oceans, climb treacherous slopes, survive endless volcanoes, and even walk through clouds. But Tom-Tom will never be totally alone. You see, when he goes through the exotic locations, he has to come face to face with its inhabitants, like bees, spiders, snakes, coal-kids, frogs, bats, snails, coyotes, and octopuses, to name a few. The hatchet is Tom-Tom's only line of defense against these menaces.

name: World Geography Series : States & Capitals Tutorial
desc: World Geography Series: States & Capitals Tutorial focuses on learning the U.S. states and their capitals. This educational program guides you step by step through all the states, using questions, repetitions, and exercises to help you retain the knowledge. It's a playful way to ensure you memorize the names and capitals – a foundation considered essential in American schools.

name: Zaxxon
desc: Zaxxon delivers the classic space combat experience in an isometric 3D perspective. You pilot a fighter craft through a heavily fortified base filled with gun turrets, missiles, and radar stations. Your mission is to destroy as many targets as possible while avoiding enemy fire and managing your fuel – which, paradoxically, is replenished by blowing up fuel tanks. This cartridge version differs from the UK disk release with faster gameplay, slightly altered level design, and tighter controls that more closely mirror the original arcade feel.

name: Zenji
desc: Zenji is a unique action puzzle game where you control a rolling face through a maze. Your goal is to rotate and connect each segment to the central energy source, turning the entire maze green. You're racing against the clock while avoiding flames and sparks that roam the paths. Occasionally, a number appears and counts down from 9 to 0 – touching it in time earns you bonus points. With each level, the mazes grow larger, more complex, and filled with more hazards.

name: Zone Ranger
desc: Zone Ranger is an arcade action game somewhat similar to Asteroids. You are the pilot of a spaceship in a deadly region of space. Large killer rocks, rogue satellites, boomerangs, and more all fill this region of space. Using your ships lasers you need to destroy as many of these as you can to earn points. Each level also contains some warp holes; enter one of these and you will be transported to a new location, which could be useful if you get in trouble. You will also occasionally come across some sonic sparklers; touch one of these, and you will temporarily become invincible. Another oddity you may come across is a super portal, which will transport you to the inner sanctum where bonus dots can be found.
